title: Allient Inc. to demonstrate Industrial Automation and Power Quality solutions at Automation Fair 2026 - Allient, Inc.
summary: Allient has announced it will present its industrial automation and power quality solutions at Automation Fair 2026, November 16–19 in Boston, Massachusetts.
body_markdown:
**Allient Inc. to demonstrate Industrial Automation and Power Quality solutions at Automation Fair 2026**


[Download printer-friendly version](https://allient.com/d/?h=6308bae)


**Buffalo, N.Y. – 16 November, 2026 –** Allient Inc. (Nasdaq: ALNT) (“Allient” or the “Company”), a global designer and manufacturer of advanced motion, controls, and power solutions announced that it will present its industrial automation and power quality solutions at Automation Fair 2026, taking place November 16–19 at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center in Boston, Massachusetts.


If you are attending, please visit Booth #951 to explore technologies from Allient Bellevue (Spectrum Controls) and Allient Milwaukee (TCI), or[get in touch](https://allient.com/contact-us/) to schedule a meeting during the event.


**PointMax™ I/O and Energy Monitoring from Allient Bellevue**


Allient Bellevue will feature its PointMax™ I/O modules, highlighting the 5034-EM-SC Energy Monitoring Module. Visitors will also get a first look at the 5034-BACMSTP-SC BACnet® Communications Module.


The display will include the currently available 5034-IV8-SC 8-Channel Digital Input Module and 5034-OV8-SC 8-Channel Digital Output Module, giving attendees the opportunity to learn more about the wider PointMax™ I/O range.


Allient Bellevue will also deliver presentation #PS48, “Today’s Technology, Tomorrow’s Results: Leveraging 5034 PointMax I/O to Create What’s Next,” in Room 256 on November 17 (2:00–3:00 p.m.) and November 19 (11:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.).


“We’re looking forward to connecting with attendees at Automation Fair 2026 and highlighting the capabilities of our PointMax™ I/O modules,” said Curt Simms, Vice President and General Manager, Allient Bellevue.


**Power Quality Solutions from Allient Milwaukee**


Allient Milwaukee will showcase its power quality solutions, including the HGA HarmonicGuard® Active Filter, HGP HarmonicGuard® Passive Filter, KMG Sine Wave Filter, V1K dV/dt Filter, and KDR Line and Load Reactors.


Visitors can also learn more about PQconnect™ intelligent control and its custom Add-On Profile for integration into Rockwell Automation Studio 5000 platform.


The team will introduce a new interactive demonstration this year, featuring a large touchscreen tablet kiosk that guides visitors through the product lines, 3D drawings, and simulations of the filters in action.


“Automation Fair is a great venue to connect with customers and demonstrate how TCI-branded power quality solutions can help them solve their grid compliance issues. The intelligent control and monitoring features provided by PQconnect™ are major differentiators for our customers in the Rockwell ecosystem,” said Ashish Bendre, Vice President and Group President (Bellevue, Milwaukee, Oshkosh).


To get in touch and schedule a meeting with Allient at the event, visit[here](https://allient.com/contact-us/) .


**ABOUT ALLIENT INC.**


Allient (Nasdaq: ALNT) is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction, and facility infrastructure. A family of globally responsible companies, Allient takes a One-Team approach to “Connect What Matters” and provides the most robust, reliable, and high-value products and systems by utilizing its core Motion, Controls, and Power technologies and platforms.


Headquartered in Buffalo, N.Y., Allient employs more than 2,500 team members around the world.
